eric: Noticed a spike in inference errors after rolling runtime to 3.2.0 in na-west. Thinking we should apply a temporary runtime pin for na-west-lowlatency pool while we triage. Want quick ops + QA ack.

deploy-bot: auto-detect: target=na-west-lowlatency, symptom=decode_mismatch (rate 0.8%), suggested mitigation=runtime-pin:runtime@3.1.9.

sylvia: can we scope by pool only? lowlatency pool hosts a few latency-sensitive tenants. Pin there only.
eric: yes. command: `/deploy pin runtime na-west --pool lowlatency --version runtime@3.1.9 --reason "decode_mismatch after 3.2.0"`. Change window 20m.

oncall: +1 from SRE. Keep rollback threshold error-rate > 1%. Have rollback command ready.

qa-bot: smoke summary pre-pin: api_surface PASS, decode_mismatch FAIL (0.8%), perf PASS. link: https://ci.redwood/internal/short/5612

sylvia: timeline: apply pin now, run targeted smoke at +10m, hold for 4h or until runtime patch is validated. If smoke fails, immediate rollback of pin and open incident.
eric: deploy-bot, please apply and confirm.
deploy-bot: action queued -> apply runtime-pin target=na-west pool=lowlatency version=runtime@3.1.9 requested_by=eric runbook=/runbooks/na-west-runtime-pin.md
deploy-bot: [completed] runtime pin applied id=pin-20240504-03 at 1751240042

qa-bot: post-pin smoke (10m): decode_mismatch PASS (sampled 2000 requests), api_surface PASS, perf PASS. details: https://ci.redwood/internal/short/5613

oncall: monitoring looks stable. We'll keep the pin for 4h or until patch. Documenting change in change-log and pinging account management for affected tenants.
eric: leaving checklist: [x] pin applied [x] smoke green [ ] runtime patch validated [ ] unpin scheduled. Thanks all.
